title: Recurring dreams about my backyard that doesn't exist
content: My backyard has paths you can walk down to get to the neighborhood behind our house. I've never actually gone down these paths as they're private property, but I keep dreaming about them. The world behind them is always distorted from what it normally is, I've dreamt about them so often I could even describe/illustrate what they look like, even though I have horrible memory and forget dreams very quickly. The way they look in my dreams do not match the way they are in real life. Just now I've woken up from a dream where going down these paths would send me to alternate realities (probably cliché, I know). The spaces behind usually feel unfinished, like something is missing or just heavily changed.
